definitions.full: H3617. kalah כָּלָה noun feminine completion, complete destruction, consumption, annihilation ; always this form; — 1 completion , but only as adverb, and dubious: completely, altogether Gen 18:21 (J; read כֻּלָּם Ol Kau Buhl), Exod 11:1 (si vera lectio) 2 complete destruction, consumption, annihilation: a. almost always by God, especially כ ׳עָשָׂה Isa 10:23 (+ וְנֶחֱרָצָה ), Nahum 1:8 (2 accusative, si vera lectio; Buhl ZAW 1885, 181 proposes בְּקָמָיו for מְקוֺמָהּ see Id HWB 12 Kau AT, Text Krit. Erläut. p. 65 ; see also מָקוֺם below קום ), 1:9 ; Jer 4:27 ; Neh 9:31 (2 accusative); + אֵת person = with , pregnant sense, = in dealing with (compare II. אֵת 1d ), Zeph 1:18 ( ׳כ נִבְהָלָה אַךְ ), Jer 5:18 ; 30:11 = 46:28 ( אֹתְָךָ = אִתְּךָ ), Ezek 11:13 ; 20:17 ( אוֺתָם = אִתָּם ); + בְּכָלגּֿוֺיִם Jer 30:11 ; 46:28 ; without ׳כ ׃עשׂה שָׁמַעְתִּי וְנֶחֱרָצָה Isa 28:22 , ׳עַדכֿ ׳וְנ Dan 9:27 (on both compare Isa 10:23 ; Zeph 1:18 ); לְכָלָה for annihilation Ezek 13:13 (si vera lectio, see Co), לְכ לְהַשְׁחִית ׳וְלֹא 2Chr 12:12 . b. by men, תַּעֲשׂוּ ׳וְכ אַלֿ Jer 5:10 ; ׳וְכ בְיָדוֺ Dan 11:16 and (i.e. with ) annihilation in his hand.
